name: Paracetamol
indications: Used for relief of mild to moderate pain and fever.
sideEffects: Possible side effects include nausea and rash; overdose can cause severe liver injury.
contraindications: Avoid in people with serious allergy to paracetamol. Liver disease requires professional assessment.
precautions: Check combination products to avoid accidental duplicate paracetamol exposure.
interactions: May interact with warfarin, especially with regular use; check current product information.
dosageReference: No dose provided. Refer to the exact product label and qualified clinician.

name: Ibuprofen
indications: Used for pain, inflammation and fever.
sideEffects: May cause indigestion, stomach pain, nausea and gastrointestinal bleeding.
contraindications: May be unsuitable with certain ulcers, NSAID allergy, kidney or heart conditions.
precautions: Professional advice is important during pregnancy and in kidney disease or older adults.
interactions: May interact with anticoagulants, other NSAIDs and some blood-pressure medicines.
dosageReference: No dose provided. Refer to the exact product label and qualified clinician.

name: Cetirizine
indications: Used to relieve allergy symptoms such as sneezing, itching and runny nose.
sideEffects: May cause sleepiness, dry mouth, headache and fatigue.
contraindications: Check suitability in severe kidney problems or allergy to the medicine.
precautions: May cause drowsiness; avoid driving if affected.
interactions: Alcohol and sedating medicines may increase drowsiness.
dosageReference: No dose provided. Refer to the exact product label and qualified clinician.

name: Amoxicillin
indications: Prescription antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections.
sideEffects: May cause nausea, diarrhoea and rash; serious allergic reactions can occur.
contraindications: Serious penicillin allergy requires avoidance and professional assessment.
precautions: Prescription medicine. Use only when prescribed for the specific infection.
interactions: May interact with warfarin, methotrexate and other medicines.
dosageReference: No dose provided. Dose depends on infection, age, kidney function and clinical assessment.

name: Metformin
indications: Used to help control blood glucose in type 2 diabetes.
sideEffects: May cause nausea, diarrhoea and abdominal discomfort; long-term use may lower vitamin B12.
contraindications: May be unsuitable with severe kidney impairment or metabolic acidosis.
precautions: Kidney function monitoring and clinician advice around contrast imaging are important.
interactions: Some medicines and alcohol may affect safety or glucose control.
dosageReference: No dose provided. Individualized prescription; refer to approved product information.
